text: Nine A.M. Board meeting. And the deck doesn't match the model.
You ask a chatbot to update the board memo.
It says it's done.
Then you open the file... and the formatting's wrecked.
So you fix it by hand. Then, an email.
Please update the model and the board deck to match, before the meeting.
So you ask it for the deck... and it builds one, in the chat.
Then, one number changes.
Prompt again. Wait again. Five minutes... for one number.
Done. Except now... slide four changed.
Five tabs. Copy. Paste. Check. Repeat.
The worst part? You don't even know what's wrong anymore.
See exactly what changed. Decide what stays.
Meet Agentic Office. Your Word, Excel and PowerPoint, in one workspace.
Tell it what changed. Once.
It finds where that number lives: the model, the memo, the deck.
And drafts each fix in place, for you to review.
Every change is marked, in every file. You accept it, or reject it.
Even slide four.
Done. And this time, you've seen every change.
Agentic Office.
